data.recommendation:
Adopt six arms: CIC-only, UNSW-only and joint-source training, each with released and scratch initialization. BOTH CSVs supply validated packet bytes and CSV-supplied benign/attack labels to a separately versioned NetMamba+ packet adaptation. Joint training directly tests pooling; reciprocal evaluation of single-source models tests transfer without target-source fitting or checkpoint selection.

Use the reported native fuse3_mamba_classifier configuration as the implementation target: arr_length=1500, stride_size=4, seq_len=0, num_classes=2; input [B,1,1,1500] normalized as 2*b/255-1 and two empty [B,0] tensors. Retain every byte slot, including zeros. Preserve native blocks, residual/RMSNorm behavior and summary pooling. The proposed 378-token sequence has two constant prefixes and a final byte summary; the prefixes do not represent observed flow sizes or timing. Use a new bias-free [2,256] head. Labels, metadata and source identity never enter forward.

Released initialization uses compatible trunk states from fuse3_mamba.pth, reported SHA-256 16e5a7f61c55a5be7a3feb535a59cbb780817f42f29a5840ea34841da243b5d9, with position slices [20:21], [41:42], [42:417], [442:443]. Audit loaded, omitted and newly initialized states; reject unexplained mismatches. Scratch controls must use the same positional coordinates: apply that remap to fresh native 443-position initialization, rather than generating a new 378-position coordinate system. Preserve native positional trainability. If positions are fixed, require identical positional tensors across initialization pairs; if learned, explicitly include their transfer in the treatment and document scratch initialization. Seed paired new heads identically. These source facts still require confirmation as identified below.

Freeze a global seeded 70/15/15 split by canonical 1,500-byte input hash across BOTH exports before training. Keep duplicate and conflicting-label groups intact. Preserve original labels and use an explicit source-specific binary allowlist: CIC BENIGN and UNSW normal map to zero; enumerated remaining intake labels map to one; unknown labels fail validation. Cap each source at 100,000 training groups and 20,000 groups per validation/test partition using deterministic selection. Sample training groups uniformly and average cross-entropy over each group's observed label proportions. Joint training samples sources equally, retaining source-specific label counts. Never majority-relabel conflicts. Report actual row/group supports and source exposures.

Freeze seed 0, batch 64, float32, AdamW, weight decay 0.05, and constant trunk/head learning rates 0.0001/0.001. Choose one common budget, in multiples of 100 up to 1,000 updates per arm, using timing alone before supervised scores. Keep GPU work, including validation and final inference, within 60 minutes with evaluation time reserved. Completion requires at least 100 genuine-label updates and completed held-out inference for every arm. An interrupted or unequal-budget study remains incomplete and cannot support comparative benefit claims. Validate every 100 updates; select group-weighted binary macro-F1, earliest ties, using only own-source validation for single-source arms and the equal-source mean for joint arms. Fix threshold 0.5 and freeze selections before test evaluation.

Evaluate every model on both held-out source partitions. Save predictions and source-specific label counts for independent recomputation of row- and group-weighted confusion matrices, macro-F1, balanced accuracy, AUROC and attack-class average precision where defined. Give each group total weight one under group weighting. Report subtype and conflicting-group slices. Include train-fitted majority, byte-histogram linear and metadata-only controls. Disclose unknown released-checkpoint exposure and that exact-hash separation does not establish capture independence. Publish negative transfer faithfully as a one-seed, fixed-budget result; accuracy improvement is not an acceptance condition.

Compared alternatives: direct packet adaptation provides the immediate native-model role; the joint arms test shared training explicitly. Byte-domain reconstruction followed by isolated flow training is a distinct follow-up requiring reconstruction/position controls and honest downstream validation; evaluation on the previously published test set would be retrospective. Real flow use requires verified capture identity, ordering, direction and timing. The available evidence does not establish those joins, so adjacent CSV rows must never become invented flows.

Update README.md, docs/repository-walkthrough.md, docs/customer/paper-and-data-explained.md and docs/customer/upstream-comparison.md. Extend tools/verify_package.py after inspecting its complete implementation to validate packet artifacts and current inventory while retaining historical media checks against their frozen edition.

Acceptance additionally requires finite nonzero byte-projection/encoder gradients and optimizer changes, native token/pooling assertions, zero global input-hash overlap between partitions, strict checkpoint reload with matching logits, unlabeled inference, and independently recomputed metrics. Preserve original flow checkpoints, mappings, measured results and fixed video/PDF/PPT/transcript artifacts. Clearly identify the packet study as a later addition. Review affected lesson sources and references; leave unresolved content/video reviews visible and never advance coverage baselines solely to clear a badge.
